stages.name: Monster of Acting
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the Control Center, <$cc.bd_mujica><@cc.rem>Passion</></> <@cc.vup>+20</>; for every <@cc.vup>8</> <$cc.bd_mujica><@cc.rem>Passion</></>, self Morale consumed per hour <@cc.vdown>+0.01</> and all Trading Posts' order efficiency <@cc.vup>+1%</> (Only the strongest effect of this type takes place)

stages.name: Halves of a Whole
